_why_this_file_exists: This is the committed 'known good' triage evaluation number. CI cannot regenerate it, because eval/run_eval.py drives the real pipeline and needs a live local Ollama server with mistral + nomic-embed-text pulled, which a hosted runner does not have. So this file is the reference point a human compares future manual runs against.
_never_auto_written_by_ci: This file changes ONLY when a human deliberately re-runs `python eval/run_eval.py` and accepts the new number. The model samples and the number also drifts with the model and Ollama versions, so silently auto-accepting a fresh value in CI would turn real drift (or a genuine regression) into a rubber stamp. Update it by hand, in the same commit as the refreshed eval/results.md.
_how_to_update: 1) run `python eval/run_eval.py` locally (Ollama up), 2) read eval/results.md, 3) copy the overall accuracy and the P1 under-triage check here, 4) commit this file together with eval/results.md.
